description:
ANKA — We're building a similarity engine that scans Earth with open NASA data to find overlooked regions resembling the Moon and Mars. We validate it against known analogs like the Atacama and Haughton Crater, then surface the unrecognized ones. Python, data analysis, interactive maps.

Looking for: Python/data analysis, GIS or map visualization, graphic design, presentation, English writing. Geology interest a plus, not required.
